plan.name: Name
plan.copied: Copied to __count__ day(s) — remember to save
plan.no_setpoint: No time on this day: the last set point of the previous day stays active.
plan.overrides_text: Value used instead of the schedule while the matching mode is active.
plan.devices_text: Only devices compatible with the schedule type are listed.
plan.period_text_season: This schedule only runs in __season__ (current season: __current__).
plan.period_text_always: This schedule runs all year, whatever the season.
plan.base_hint_heating: Temperature kept the rest of the time (eco, night…).
plan.base_hint_cooling: The rest of the time: off, or a comfort temperature.
plan.base_hint_fan: Speed the rest of the time (0% = off).
plan.overlap: Overlaps another slot: the lowest one in the list wins.
plan.no_day: No day selected: this slot never applies.
plan.no_slot: No time slot: the “outside” value applies all the time.
plan.legend: Tap a slot in the chart to edit it.
plan.test_none: No device in this schedule: pick zones or devices.
plan.status_disabled: enable it to control the devices
plan.room_hint_display: The room temperature is displayed (overview, widget, virtual thermostat). Each device keeps regulating with its own sensor.
plan.room_hint_regulate_heating: ThermoPlan sends the set point when the room drops below “set point − margin” and puts devices on standby above “set point + margin” (off, or 7 °C for radiator valves).
plan.room_hint_regulate_cooling: ThermoPlan starts the air conditioning when the room exceeds “set point + margin” and stops it below “set point − margin”.
plan.room_hint_regulate_fan: Fans run at the schedule’s speed when the room rises above “threshold + margin” and stop below “threshold − margin”. An “off” slot stays off.
plan.room_example_fan: Example, threshold __t__: fans on from __high__, off below __low__.
plan.room_example_heating: Example, set point __t__: heats below __low__, standby from __high__.
plan.room_example_cooling: Example, set point __t__: cools from __high__, off below __low__.
plan.window_enable: Stop when a window is open
plan.window_value_cooling: While open: air conditioning off. It resumes its schedule when closed.
plan.window_hint_heating: Frost protection (7 °C) recommended for valves that cannot switch off. The schedule resumes when closed.
plan.window_scope_plan_hint: A door or window open in any of the schedule’s zones stops all its devices.
plan.window_scope_device_hint: Only the devices in the room where the door or window is open are stopped.
plan.window_auto_none: No contact sensor in the zones of this schedule’s devices.
plan.window_no_contacts: No contact sensor (alarm_contact) found on this Homey.

options.season_text: In “Automatic” mode, summer (cooling & fans) runs between these two dates (MM-DD). The rest of the year is winter (heating). These dates are also the fallback of the “By outdoor temperature” mode while no reading is available.
options.outdoor_text: In “By outdoor temperature” mode, the season follows the rolling average of the selected sensor: summer above the first threshold, winter below the second, mid-season (nothing controlled) in between. A 1 °C margin prevents repeated switching.
options.outdoor_heat: Winter when the average drops to (°C)
options.bad_outdoor: Invalid thresholds: the summer threshold must be above the winter one, and the duration between 1 and 72 h.
options.conflicts_text: When a device belongs to several active schedules, which set point wins?
options.away_text: When nobody is home (Homey users’ presence), every schedule is paused, and resumes as soon as someone is back.
options.away_no_users: No Homey user with presence enabled: use the “Away” Flow card.
options.backup_text: Copy this text to back up your schedules. Pasting other content and pressing “Restore” replaces all schedules (backups from the original app are accepted).
options.bad_backup: Invalid content: a JSON list is expected.
options.confirm_restore: Replace all schedules with the __count__ pasted schedule(s)?
